reason: E2 directly supports ~20% force-constant fluctuations in FeCoCrMnNi and their link to phonon scattering, but it does not show that binary-derived descriptors can be transferred to multi-component HEAs for predictive modeling, nor does it demonstrate a 30% reduction in predicted thermal conductivity. E1 and E3 are irrelevant to the key premises.
premises: Force-constant fluctuations in HEAs can be estimated from binary alloy data and a curated set of multi-component HEA data
Lattice distortions exceeding 20% (force-constant fluctuations) can be quantified via XRD and TEM
Severe lattice distortions enhance phonon scattering and reduce phonon mean free paths, lowering lattice thermal conductivity
A DFT-ML model using these descriptors can predict phonon thermal conductivity at least 30% lower than conventional DFT methods
